Luis Elizondo, who ran a Pentagon program that studied UFO reports, joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2194. Elizondo left government and became the public face of military UFO disclosure. His testimony has put pilots' sightings in front of Congress and the press.

He tells Rogan what the program saw, what the videos show, and why he thinks officials still hide the full picture. Rogan asks what the craft might be and who might build them. The episode is a key record in the modern disclosure story, from the man at the center of it.
podcast-joerogan-r0J3EUxcgCM:
Joe Rogan asks what is going on with alien abductions in a segment from his show. The topic is the long wave of tales in which people say beings took them at night. Rogan hosts the tour of the claims.

Rogan works through the shape of the tales: lost time, bright rooms, and beings with big eyes. He weighs the takes of fans, doctors, and doubters on what could drive such shared tales. The segment is short and open. Listeners get a brisk map of a famed fringe claim. The library holds the file as an archive record, without a side taken.
